title: Abandon merged work
summary: A caller with items.write permission on the project may abandon merged work that cannot finish, preserving merge evidence and recording a durable resolution audit. Membership in any non-terminal deployment run refuses merged_item_live_deployment_run. Remove the member through the separately audited deployment-runs remove-item command before retrying; its removal gates still apply. If removal is unavailable, finish or cancel the run first. Terminal memberships remain history; delivered items cannot be abandoned.
